Requirement text: The system shall allow a registered user to log in using valid credentials.
The system shall allow an authenticated user to send a message in a channel where the user has permission to post.
The system shall allow authorized users to create or manage channels according to their assigned permissions.
The system shall allow users to search messages using supported search criteria and modifiers.
The system shall allow users to attach and share supported files through messages.
The system shall allow a new user to register an account; invalid input (e.g. invalid email or a password shorter than the configured minimum) shall be rejected.
Common operations (opening channels and searching messages) respond with p95 <= 1000 ms each under 5 concurrent users x 10 iterations with 0 errors.
